newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end modestly higher but gains limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end modestly higher but gains limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended modestly higher on Wednesday as investors, encouraged by the yen's recent weakness, sought relatively low-priced shares that are sensitive to the economy.
But some high-priced blue chips were capped by profit-taking, limiting overall gains.
A rebound in the long-strapped financial sector also provided relief to the market, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average climbed 97.61 points or 0.54 percent to close at 18,031.20. It briefly rose to 18,093.91.
Nikkei June futures added 80 points to finish at 18,040.
